run_NLVR_inference: run NLVR inference on a pair of images and a text query using NLVRInferencer
list_NLVR_models: list all available NLVR model names using NLVRInferencer.list_models with an optional pattern
preprocess_NLVR_inputs: preprocess NLVR inputs by loading two images and text into a batched pipeline
postprocess_NLVR_predictions: postprocess NLVR predictions to extract pred_scores, pred_label, and pred_score from DataSample objects
init_NLVR_pipeline: initialize the NLVR test pipeline from a config by building transforms with ApplyToList scatter
